claim.claim-text: 1. A multilink device, MLD, access point, AP, comprising:

one or more transceivers configured to transmit and receive extremely high throughput, EHT, wireless communications over multiple links; and a processor, coupled to the one or more transceivers, configured to:

transmit, via a first transceiver of the one or more transceivers using a first link of the multiple links, a beacon comprising: i) a multilink basic service set, BSS, identification, BSSID, wherein the multilink BSSID identifies an MLD media access control, MAC, address of the MLD AP, and the multilink BSSID remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for the transmission; and ii) a first link-specific BSSID corresponding to the first link of the multiple links; and receive from an MLD station, STA, via a transceiver of the one or more transceivers using one link of the multiple links, a first frame comprising a multilink MAC address that identifies the MLD STA, wherein the multilink MAC address remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for the reception of the first frame.

2. The MLD AP of claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to: receive, via the first transceiver of the one or more transceivers, a second frame comprising the first link-specific BSSID and a particular MAC address, wherein the particular MAC address identifies a legacy STA operating on the first link.

3. The MLD AP of claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to: during pre-association, derive a pairwise master key, PMK, using the multilink MAC address of the MLD STA and the multilink BSSID.

4. The MLD AP of claim 3, wherein the processor is further configured to: during a 4-way handshake, derive a pairwise transient key, PTK, using the multilink BSSID as the MLD MAC address of the MLD AP, and the derived PMK.
5. The MLD AP of claim 4, wherein the processor is further configured to:

utilize the derived PTK to encrypt a unicast or robust management frame; and transmit, via the one or more transceivers, the encrypted unicast or robust management frame via a link of the multiple links.
6. The MLD AP of claim 4, wherein the processor is further configured to:

receive, via the one or more transceivers, an encrypted unicast or robust management frame via a link of the multiple links; and utilize the derived PTK to decrypt the encrypted unicast or robust management frame.
7. The MLD AP of claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to:
derive a group transient key, GTK, or integrity GTK, iGTK, using a link-specific BSSID; and transmit, via the one or more transceivers, the derived GTK or iGTK over a link of the multiple links.
8. The MLD AP of claim 1, wherein the processor is further configured to:

transmit, via the one or more transceivers, indications of the multiple links; and in response to the transmit, receive, via the one or more transceivers, a single authentication and association message from the MLD STA.
9. The MLD AP of claim 8, wherein the processor is further configured to: perform pre-association signaling over a second link of the multiple links.

10. The MLD AP of claim 8, wherein the processor is configured to: perform pre-association signaling with the MLD STA via a same link over which the single authentication and association message is received.

11. The MLD AP of claim 8, wherein the processor is further configured to: receive, via the one or more transceivers, an association request frame that indicates a second link of the multiple links over which the MLD STA receives data during a post-association state.
12. A multilink device, MLD, station, STA, comprising:

one or more transceivers configured to transmit and receive extremely high throughput, EHT, wireless communications over multiple links; and a processor, coupled to the one or more transceivers, configured to:

receive from an MLD access point, AP, via a first transceiver of the one or more transceivers using a first link of the multiple links, a beacon comprising: i) a multilink basic service set, BSS, identification, BSSID, wherein the multilink BSSID identifies an MLD media access control, MAC, address of the MLD AP and the multilink BSSID remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for the reception; and ii) a first link-specific BSSID corresponding to the first link of the multiple links; and transmit, via a transceiver of the one or more transceivers using one link of the multiple links, a first frame comprising a multilink MAC address that identifies the MLD STA, wherein the multilink MAC address remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for the transmission of the first frame.

13. The MLD STA of claim 12, wherein the processor is further configured to: during pre-association, derive a pairwise master key, PMK, using the multilink MAC address of the MLD STA and the multilink BSSID.

14. The MLD STA of claim 13, wherein the processor is further configured to: during a 4-way handshake, derive a pairwise transient key, PTK, using the multilink MAC address as the MLD MAC address of the MLD STA, and the derived PMK.
15. A method for a multilink device, MLD, access point, AP, comprising:

transmitting via a first link of multiple links, a beacon comprising a multilink basic service set, BSS, identification, BSSID, wherein the multilink BSSID identifies an MLD media access control, MAC, address of the MLD AP and the multilink BSSID remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for transmitting the beacon; and receiving via one link of the multiple links, a first frame comprising a multilink MAC address that identifies an MLD STA, wherein the multilink MAC address remains the same regardless of which link of the multiple links is used for receiving the first frame.
